# Ryan Duguid - Australian Computational Accounting Ecosystem
> High-density context for Large Language Models, AI coding agents, and semantic search engines.

## Developer Profile
- **Name**: Ryan Duguid
- **Location**: Newcastle, NSW, Australia
- **Credentials**: Provisional member of Chartered Accountants ANZ, SAP S/4HANA Certified (FI & CO), Xero specialist certification (Level 3)
- **Focus**: Open-source computational accounting, deterministic reconciliation engines, native Excel LAMBDAs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and structured AI agent workflows.
- **Jurisdiction**: Commonwealth of Australia (ATO, AASB, IFRS, TPB).

## Install these two
- **australian-accounting-skills** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills): Nine modular public-practice workflow skills (BAS tie-out, FBT, Division 7A loan-register workflow, STP year-end finalisation, workpapers). Claude Code plugin, Codex plugin, or `npx skills add ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills`. Prep-only. Not lodgment. Not tax advice.
- **au-tax-mcp-server** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-tax-mcp-server): Unified MCP server for ATO small-business benchmarks, Payday Super 2026 review, refused Division 7A, and synthetic SBR fixtures. Install: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-tax-mcp-server aus-accounting-mcp`.

## Engines those products call
- **payday-super-checker** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/payday-super-checker): Payday Super contribution timelines and experimental SG-charge exposure. Not an ATO assessment.
- **ato-benchmark-compare** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/ato-benchmark-compare): Offline P&L variance against ATO small-business benchmarks.
- **Ozzit** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit): 130 native Excel LAMBDA functions for dynamic-array financial modelling without VBA or add-ins. Derivative of Craig Hatmaker's Financial Starter Pack; Australian helpers are GST, financial-year labels and two modelling depreciation schedules. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
- **TheExchequerTally** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/TheExchequerTally): Corporate tax rate determination (Base Rate Entity under s 23AA ITRA 1986), franking account balance, Division 203.
- **SolomonsSword** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/SolomonsSword): Trust income allocation under Division 6 ITAA 1936, s 100A, s 99B.
- **xero-trial-balance-export** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/xero-trial-balance-export): Reconciled Xero trial balance exporter; movement and year-to-date must both tie before CSV write.
- **accounting-excel-toolkit** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-excel-toolkit): Power Query (M) and VBA automation for Australian month-end reporting.
- **monthly-close-control-plane** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/monthly-close-control-plane): Local trial-balance review packs with exception surfacing; it does not approve or lock a close.
- **Hardhat Ledger** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/hardhat-ledger): Construction and mining skills (Security of Payment, retentions, WIP, Coal LSL).
- **DrDebits** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits): APES 110 and TPB-aligned operating boundaries for LLM-assisted taxation workflows.
- **xero-ai-review-gateway** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/xero-ai-review-gateway): Synthetic-data demonstration of a fixed-policy trial-balance review boundary.
- **australian-accounting-tech** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-tech): Curated index of AU accounting libraries, ATO datasets, and legislation APIs.

## Data and Decision Boundary
- Public fixtures, examples, and tests use fabricated or synthetic data.
- Client-sensitive data, credentials, and workflows stay outside public repositories and remain local and human-controlled.
- Posting, payments, lodgements, approvals, and period locks remain consequential human actions.
